summary: HSBC Holdings, through subsidiary HSBC Bank Australia, agreed on 31 July 2026 to sell its AUD36 billion (US$25 billion) Australian home and personal loan portfolio to Virgo BidCo Pty Ltd, owned by Blackstone-managed funds. Consideration is cash at base amount plus adjustments, with closing expected H1 2027 subject to regulatory and competition approvals. HSBC expects an immaterial loss, US$0.3 billion restructuring costs, and recycling of US$0.3 billion FX reserve losses. Pepper Money will service the loans. The remainder of HSBC Australia's retail business will wind down over 18 months, consolidating other units into HSBC's Sydney branch. Watch regulatory approvals and whether HSBC provides senior financing, impacting deal completion risk.
